statements.subject: server
statements.description: Server has received a request bearing an unsupported A2A protocol version and returns a 400 error; the interaction terminates with a version-not-supported condition.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Scenario: Client requests an unsupported protocol version. Server responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request and application/problem+json body including supportedVersions.
actions: Server receives POST /message:send with A2A-Version header value 0.5
Server determines requested version 0.5 is not in its supported versions list
Server returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with Content-Type: application/problem+json
Response body includes type, title, status, detail, and supportedVersions fields

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The version-not-supported error response body contains a 'type' field identifying the error as https://a2a-protocol.org/errors/version-not-supported.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The version-not-supported error response body contains a 'title' field with human-readable error title.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The version-not-supported error response body contains a 'status' field with HTTP status code 400.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The version-not-supported error response body contains a 'detail' field describing which version was rejected and why.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The version-not-supported error response body contains a 'supportedVersions' field listing the A2A protocol versions the agent does support, e.g. ["0.3"].
